# neurodegenerative disease (ND)

PP216 Group C; Recruited as "MCI/vascular cognition loss"; reviewed as MCI, MoCA 20/30; labelled as Dementia in my final list. OHRI patients, I can send you the MRN if needed. PP262 Group A; primary neurodegenerative dementia syndrome, most likely AD; Recruited as AD, reviewed as Dementia, with note "Specific etiology unclear." OHRI patient, can be further reviewed. PP274 Group C; EBH patient, recruited as "Advanced MCI". No review note in the master sheet, labelled as Dementia in my final list. Now deceased. PP367 Group B; EBH patient, reviewed as Vascular dementia, with MoCA 26/30

```{r}
group_ND <- read.csv("Worksheets/diagnosis group_ND.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))

data$group_ND <- rep("",nrow(data))
for (diagnosis in group_ND$Diagnosis){
  data$group_ND[which(data$diagnosis == diagnosis)] <- group_ND$Group_ND[which(group_ND$Diagnosis == diagnosis)]
}

data$group_ND[which(data$ID == "PP216")] <- "Group C"
data$group_ND[which(data$ID == "PP262")] <- "Group A"
data$group_ND[which(data$ID == "PP274")] <- "Group C"
data$group_ND[which(data$ID == "PP367")] <- "Group B"

table(data %>% select(diagnosis, group_ND))
```

## make the categorical variables as factor and update the labels if applicable

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

flag_print <- F
for (var in unique(variable_details$Short.name)) {
  if (flag_print) {
    print("-------------")
    print(table(data[var], useNA = "ifany"))
  }
  label_vec <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(OptionLabel)))
  label_vec <- label_vec[!is.na(label_vec)]
  
  label_vec_2 <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(ShortLabel)))
  label_vec_2 <- label_vec_2[!is.na(label_vec_2)]
  
  if (!all(label_vec==label_vec_2)) # need to update labels
  {
    vec <- unlist(data[var])
    for (i in seq_len(length(label_vec))){
      vec[which(vec == label_vec[i])] <- label_vec_2[i]
    }
    data[var] <- vec
  }
  
  # make it factor with proper levels
  data[names(data)[which(names(data) == var)]] <- 
    lapply(data[names(data)[which(names(data) == var)]], factor, levels = label_vec_2)
  if (flag_print) {
    print(table(data[var], useNA = "ifany"))
    print(lapply(data[names(data)[which(names(data) == var)]], levels))
  }
}

# drop levels since some options in the variable detail sheet were never chosen
data <- data %>% droplevels()

levels(data$group) <- c("HC", "PD", "OND")
levels(data$group2) <- c("HC", "PD", "MSA/PSP", "MCI/DEM", "AON")
```

## ROC, AUC

### Table 3: all components

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

source("util.R", echo = TRUE)

# --------- median (IQR) ---------
var_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
name_vec <- variables$Long.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]

for (i_cohort in 1:3) {
  if (i_cohort == 1)
    # PREDIGT1 cohort
  {
    df_roc_temp <- data
  } else if (i_cohort == 2)
    # UPSIT cohort
  {
    df_roc_temp <- data %>% filter(!is.na(PREDIGT_O_UPSIT)) %>% droplevels()
  } else
    # all_component
  {
    df_roc_temp <- df_PREDIGT2
  }
  
  df_O_tbl1 <- df_roc_temp %>%
    select(group, group2, sex, all_of(var_vec))
  names(df_O_tbl1)[c(4:ncol(df_O_tbl1))] <- name_vec
  
  # all
  print(df_O_tbl1 %>% select(-c(group2, sex)) %>%
    tbl_summary(
      by = group,
      missing = "no",
      type = list("NeuroScent score" ~ "continuous")
    ) %>%
    add_p() %>%
    add_q() %>%
    modify_header(label = "**Variable**") %>% # update the column header
    modify_caption("All") %>%
    bold_labels() %>%
    bold_p(t = 0.05))
  
  # Female
  print(df_O_tbl1 %>% filter(sex == "Female") %>% droplevels() %>%
    select(-c(group2, sex)) %>%
    tbl_summary(
      by = group,
      missing = "no",
      type = list("NeuroScent score" ~ "continuous")
    ) %>%
    add_p() %>%
    add_q() %>%
    modify_header(label = "**Variable**") %>% # update the column header
    modify_caption("Female") %>%
    bold_labels() %>%
    bold_p(t = 0.05))
  
  # Male
  print(df_O_tbl1 %>% filter(sex == "Male") %>% droplevels() %>%
    select(-c(group2, sex)) %>%
    tbl_summary(
      by = group,
      missing = "no",
      type = list("NeuroScent score" ~ "continuous")
    ) %>%
    add_p() %>%
    add_q() %>%
    modify_header(label = "**Variable**") %>% # update the column header
    modify_caption("Male") %>%
    bold_labels() %>%
    bold_p(t = 0.05))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# --------- ROC/AUC ---------

test_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
test_vec2 <- variables$Long.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
type1_vec <- variables$Type1[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
type2_vec <- variables$Type2[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
group_name <- levels(data$group)
directions <- c("<", "<", ">", ">", "<", "<")

resList <- list()
for (i_cohort in 1:3) {
  if (i_cohort == 1)
    # PREDIGT1 cohort
  {
    df_roc_temp <- data
  } else if (i_cohort == 2)
    # UPSIT cohort
  {
    df_roc_temp <- data %>% filter(!is.na(PREDIGT_O_UPSIT)) %>% droplevels()
  } else
    # all_component
  {
    df_roc_temp <- df_PREDIGT2
  }
  
  df <- df_roc_temp %>%
    mutate(group3 = ifelse(group == "PD", "PD", "HC+OND"))
  levels(df$group3) <- c("HC+OND", "PD")
  table(df %>% select(group, group3))
  compareList <- list(c("HC", "PD"), c("OND", "PD"), c("HC+OND", "PD"))
  
  dfPlt <- data.frame()
  res <- data.frame()
  for (i in seq_len(length(test_vec))) {
    df_i <- df %>% select(group, group3, sex, all_of(test_vec[i]))
    names(df_i)[ncol(df_i)] <- "value"
    
    for (i_group in 1:3) {
      # ------- All -------
      if (i_group < 3) {
        df_temp <- df_i %>% select(group, value, sex)
      } else {
        df_temp <- df_i %>% select(group3, value, sex)
        names(df_temp)[names(df_temp) == "group3"] <- "group"
      }
      
      result_A <- ROC_summary(df_temp,
                              compareList[[i_group]],
                              test_vec2[i],
                              type1_vec[i],
                              type2_vec[i],
                              direction = directions[i])
      dfPlt <- bind_rows(dfPlt, result_A$dfPlt)
      res <- bind_rows(res, result_A$res)
      
      #  ------- Female -------
      df_temp_F <- df_temp %>% filter(sex == "Female") %>% droplevels()
      
      result_F <- ROC_summary(
        df_temp_F,
        compareList[[i_group]],
        test_vec2[i],
        type1_vec[i],
        type2_vec[i],
        sex = "Female",
        cut_all = result_A$cut_all,
        direction = directions[i]
      )
      dfPlt <- bind_rows(dfPlt, result_F$dfPlt)
      res <- bind_rows(res, result_F$res)
      
      #  ------- Male -------
      df_temp_M <- df_temp %>% filter(sex == "Male") %>% droplevels()
      
      result_M <- ROC_summary(
        df_temp_M,
        compareList[[i_group]],
        test_vec2[i],
        type1_vec[i],
        type2_vec[i],
        sex = "Male",
        cut_all = result_A$cut_all,
        direction = directions[i]
      )
      dfPlt <- bind_rows(dfPlt, result_M$dfPlt)
      res <- bind_rows(res, result_M$res)
    }
  }
  # save result
  resList[[i_cohort]] <- res
}

res_PREDIGT1 <- resList[[1]]
res_UPSIT <- resList[[2]]
res_all_component <- resList[[3]]

res_all_component %>% filter(sex == "All")
res_all_component %>% filter(sex == "Female")
res_all_component %>% filter(sex == "Male")
```

## Sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV

### Figure 4, Supplementary Figure 3

```{r}
# Thresholds based on LR+, LR-
df <- dfPlt %>% filter(sex == "All") %>% droplevels()

gr <- expand_grid(unique(df$tests), unique(df$group))
names(gr) <- c("tests", "group")

cut_1 <- bind_cols(gr, data.frame(cut_min = rep(NA, nrow(gr)),cut_max = rep(NA, nrow(gr)))) 
for (i in 1:nrow(gr)) {
  ind <- which(df$tests == as.character(cut_1[i, "tests"]) &
                                   df$group == as.character(cut_1[i, "group"]) &
                                   df$LR_p >= 10 & df$LR_n <= 0.1)
  temp <- df$thresholds[ind]
  if (length(temp) > 0) {
    cut_1$cut_min[i] <- min(temp)
    cut_1$cut_max[i] <- max(temp)
  }
}
cut_1$tests <- factor(cut_1$tests, levels = unique(df$tests))
cut_1$group <- factor(cut_1$group, levels = unique(df$group))
# check for plotting
inds <- which(cut_1$cut_max == cut_1$cut_min)
cut_1[inds,]$cut_max <- cut_1[inds,]$cut_max + 0.2
cut_1

cut_2 <- bind_cols(gr, data.frame(cut_min = rep(NA, nrow(gr)),cut_max = rep(NA, nrow(gr)))) 
for (i in 1:nrow(gr)) {
  temp <- df$thresholds[which(df$tests == as.character(cut_2[i, "tests"]) &
                                   df$group == as.character(cut_2[i, "group"]) &
                                   df$LR_p >= 5 & df$LR_n <= 0.2)]
  if (length(temp) > 0) {
    cut_2$cut_min[i] <- min(temp)
    cut_2$cut_max[i] <- max(temp)
  }
}
cut_2$tests <- factor(cut_2$tests, levels = unique(df$tests))
cut_2$group <- factor(cut_2$group, levels = unique(df$group))
# check for plotting
inds <- which(cut_2$cut_max == cut_2$cut_min)
cut_2[inds,]$cut_max <- cut_2[inds,]$cut_max + 0.2
cut_2
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.3

# Figure 4: PD vs HC+OND

ttlvec <- c("Original Questionnaire", "Simplified Questionnaire", 
            "Original Smell Test (UPSIT)", "Simplified Smell Test", 
            "Original PREDIGT", "Simplified PREDIGT")

ttlvec2 <- c("Original Questionnaire", "Simplified Questionnaire", 
            "Original Smell Test", "Simplified Smell Test", 
            "Original PREDIGT", "Simplified PREDIGT")

for (i in seq_len(length(unique(dfPlt$tests)))) {
  test_i <- unique(dfPlt$tests)[i]
  df <- dfPlt %>% filter(tests == test_i, sex =="All", group == "PD vs HC+OND") %>% droplevels()
  df_long <- df %>% 
    pivot_longer(-c(thresholds, tests, group, sex, type1, type2), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") 
  df_long$metric <- factor(df_long$metric, levels = c("sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv", "LR_p", "LR_n"))
  levels(df_long$metric) <- c("sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv", "LR+", "LR-")
  df_long <- df_long %>% mutate(metric2 = factor(ifelse(metric %in% c("sensitivity", "specificity"), 2, 1)))
  
  res_i <- res %>% filter(tests == test_i, sex =="All", group == "PD vs HC+OND") %>% droplevels()
  res_i$cut_all <- as.numeric(str_extract(res_i$cut_all, "-?\\d+\\.?\\d*"))
  
  # sensitivity, specificity, ppv, npv
  p1 <- ggplot(df_long %>% filter(!(metric %in% c("LR+", "LR-"))) %>% droplevels(),
              aes(thresholds, value, color = metric, linewidth = metric2)) +
    geom_path(size = 1) +
    geom_vline(data = res_i,
               aes(xintercept = cut_all),
               linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8,
               #color = "red",
               linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(
      x = ttlvec[i],
      y = "Metric",
      color = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.position = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("orange", "orangered", "blue", "green3")) +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(0.3, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1, by = 0.2)) +
    guides(linewidth = "none")+
    geom_rect(data = cut_2 %>% filter(tests == test_i, group == "PD vs HC+OND") %>% droplevels(), 
              aes(xmin = cut_min, xmax = cut_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.2, fill = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE)
  
  # LR+ and "ruling in"
  dfLR_p <- df_long %>% filter(metric == "LR+") %>% droplevels()
  max_v <- max(ceiling(max(dfLR_p$value[is.finite(dfLR_p$value)])),10)
  p2 <- ggplot(dfLR_p,
              aes(thresholds, value, color = metric)) +
    geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(data = res_i,
               aes(xintercept = cut_all),
               linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 10,
               #color = "red",
               linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 5,
               color = "red",
               linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(
      x = ttlvec2[i],
      y = "Metric",
      color = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.position = "none",
          axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("purple")) +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(0.3, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,max_v), breaks=seq(0,max_v, by = 5))+
    guides(linewidth = "none") +
    geom_rect(data = cut_2 %>% filter(tests == test_i, group == "PD vs HC+OND") %>% droplevels(), 
              aes(xmin = cut_min, xmax = cut_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.2, fill = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE)
  
  # LR- and "ruling out"
  p3 <- ggplot(df_long %>% filter(metric == "LR-") %>% droplevels(),
              aes(thresholds, value, color = metric)) +
    geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(data = res_i,
               aes(xintercept = cut_all),
               linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.1,
               #color = "red",
               linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2,
               color = "red",
               linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(
      x = ttlvec2[i],
      y = "Metric",
      color = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.position = "none",
          axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("violet")) +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(0.3, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1), breaks=seq(0,1, by = 0.1))+
    guides(linewidth = "none") +
    geom_rect(data = cut_2 %>% filter(tests == test_i, group == "PD vs HC+OND") %>% droplevels(), 
              aes(xmin = cut_min, xmax = cut_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.2, fill = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE)
  
  print(ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 3, widths = c(1,0.7,0.7)))
}
```

```{r}
# Thresholds based on LR+, LR-
df <- dfPlt %>% filter(sex == "Female") %>% droplevels()

for (i in 1:nrow(gr)) {
  ind <- which(df$tests == as.character(cut_1[i, "tests"]) &
                                   df$group == as.character(cut_1[i, "group"]) &

  temp <- df$thresholds[ind]

    cut_1$cut_min[i] <- min(temp)

  }
}

cut_1[inds,]$cut_max <- cut_1[inds,]$cut_max + 0.2
cut_1
```

```{r}
      x = ttlvec2[i],
      y = "Metric",
      color = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.position = "none",
          axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("violet")) +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(0.3, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1), breaks=seq(0,1, by = 0.1))+
    guides(linewidth = "none") +
    geom_rect(data = cut_2 %>% filter(tests == test_i, group == "PD vs HC+OND") %>% droplevels(), 
              aes(xmin = cut_min, xmax = cut_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.2, fill = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_rect(data = cut_1 %>% filter(tests == test_i, group == "PD vs HC+OND") %>% droplevels(), 
              aes(xmin = cut_min, xmax = cut_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.5, fill = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE)
  
  print(ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 3, widths = c(1,0.7,0.7)))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

# Figure 2: show thresholds by point shape
thresholds <- res_all_component %>% filter(sex == "All", group == "PD vs HC+OND") %>% droplevels() %>% select(tests, cut_all) 
thresholds$direction <- rep("",nrow(thresholds))
thresholds$cut <- rep(0,nrow(thresholds))
for (i in 1:nrow(thresholds)) {
  thresholds$direction[i] <- str_split(thresholds$cut_all[i], " ")[[1]][1]
  thresholds$cut[i] <- as.numeric(str_split(thresholds$cut_all[i], " ")[[1]][2])
}

df <- data
df$visit_alpha <- ifelse(!is.na(df$UPSIT_scr) & !is.na(df$PREDIGT_S_B_motor) & !is.na(df$neuroscent_scr), 1, 0.5)

# by group
test_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
str_vec1 <- c("Original Questionnaire", "Simplified Questionnaire", 
            paste("Original Smell Test", "(UPSIT)", sep = "\n"), "Simplified Smell Test", 
            "Original PREDIGT", "Simplified PREDIGT")
group_name <- levels(df$group)

# effect size ylim
effsize.ymax <- c(90, 200, 5, 2, 70, 80)
effsize.ymin <- c(-10, -10, -20, -6, -10, -10)
  
for (i in seq_len(length(test_vec))) {
  if (i %in% c(2,4,6)) { #Simplified
    df_i <- df %>% 
      filter(!is.na(UPSIT_scr), !is.na(PREDIGT_S_B_motor), !is.na(neuroscent_scr)) %>% droplevels() %>% 
      select(group, group2, visit_alpha, all_of(test_vec[i]))
  } else {
    df_i <- df %>% select(group, group2, visit_alpha, all_of(test_vec[i]))
  }
  names(df_i)[ncol(df_i)] <- "value"
  
  
  # p-value
  print(test_vec[i])
  for(i_group in seq_len(length(group_name))) {
    print(paste0("----- ", group_name[i_group], " -----"))
    print(paste0(round(mean(df_i$value[df_i$group == group_name[i_group]], na.rm = T), 2), " (", round(sd(df_i$value[df_i$group == group_name[i_group]], na.rm = T), 2), ")"))
  }
  print("----- comparison -----")
  print(DescTools::DunnettTest(x=df_i$value, g=df_i$group, control = group_name[1]))
  
  if (thresholds$direction[i] == ">=") {
    df_i$shape <- ifelse(df_i$value >= thresholds$cut[i], 16, 17)
  } else {
    df_i$shape <- ifelse(df_i$value <= thresholds$cut[i], 16, 17)
  }
  
  df_i <- df_i %>% filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
    droplevels() %>% 
    arrange(group2)
  
  # Plot
  multi.group <- 
    df_i %>%
    dabest(group, value, 
           idx = list(group_name),
           paired = FALSE
    )
  
  multi.group.mean_diff <- multi.group %>% mean_diff() 
  
  set.seed(100)
  print(plot(multi.group.mean_diff, color.column = group2, palette = custom.pal[which(names(custom.pal) %in% unique(df_i$group2))],
             swarmplot.params=list(alpha=df_i$visit_alpha, shape=df_i$shape), tick.fontsize = 14,
             rawplot.ylabel = str_vec1[i], effsize.ylim = c(effsize.ymin[i], effsize.ymax[i]),
             show.legend = FALSE))
}
```

# Disease duration

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ROC/AUC within different disease duration
df <- df_PREDIGT2 %>%
  mutate(group3 = ifelse(group == "PD", "PD", "HC+OND"))
levels(df$group3) <- c("HC+OND", "PD")
table(df %>% select(group, group3))
compareList <- list(c("HC", "PD"), c("OND", "PD"), c("HC+OND", "PD"))

test_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
test_vec2 <- variables$Long.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
type1_vec <- variables$Type1[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
type2_vec <- variables$Type2[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
group_name <- levels(df$group)

dfPlt_year <- data.frame()
res_year <- data.frame()

for (year in c(2, 5, 10, 15, 20, max(data$disease_duration, na.rm = T))) {
  dfPlt <- data.frame()
  res <- data.frame()
  
  df_year <- df %>% filter(group == "HC" | disease_duration <= year) %>% droplevels()
  for (i in seq_len(length(test_vec))) {
    df_i <- df_year %>% select(group, group3, sex, all_of(test_vec[i]))
    names(df_i)[ncol(df_i)] <- "value"
    
    for (i_group in 1:3) {
      if (i_group < 3) {
        df_temp <- df_i %>% select(group, value, sex)
      } else {
        df_temp <- df_i %>% select(group3, value, sex)
        names(df_temp)[names(df_temp) == "group3"] <- "group"
      }
      
      result_A <- ROC_summary(df_temp,
                              compareList[[i_group]],
                              test_vec2[i],
                              type1_vec[i],
                              type2_vec[i], 
                              direction = directions[i])
      dfPlt <- bind_rows(dfPlt, result_A$dfPlt)
      dfPlt$year <- year
      
      res <- bind_rows(res, result_A$res)
      res$year <- year
      res$nHC <- nrow(df_i %>% filter(group == "HC"))
      res$nPD <- nrow(df_i %>% filter(group == "PD"))
      res$nOND <- nrow(df_i %>% filter(group == "OND"))
    }
  }
  dfPlt_year <- bind_rows(dfPlt_year, dfPlt)
  res_year <- bind_rows(res_year, res)
}
res_year
```

```{r}
    filter(sex == "Female") %>% 
    droplevels() 
    
  multi.group <- 
    df_i_F %>%
    dabest(sex_olfaction, value, 
           idx = list(paste0("F: ", levels(df$olfaction_self))),
           paired = FALSE
    )
  
  multi.group.mean_diff <- multi.group %>% mean_diff() 
  
  set.seed(100)
  print(plot(multi.group.mean_diff, color.column = group2, palette = custom.pal[which(names(custom.pal) %in% unique(df_i_F$group2))],
             tick.fontsize = 14, # swarmplot.params=list(alpha=df_i_F$visit_alpha), 
             rawplot.ylabel = str_vec1[i],
             show.legend = FALSE))
  
  # Plot: M
  df_i_M <- df_i %>%
    filter(sex == "Male") %>% 
    droplevels() 
    
  multi.group <- 
    df_i_M %>% 
    dabest(sex_olfaction, value, 
           idx = list(paste0("M: ", levels(df$olfaction_self))),
           paired = FALSE
    )
  
  multi.group.mean_diff <- multi.group %>% mean_diff() 
  
  set.seed(100)
  print(plot(multi.group.mean_diff, color.column = group2, palette = custom.pal[which(names(custom.pal) %in% unique(df_i_M$group2))],
             tick.fontsize = 14, # swarmplot.params=list(alpha=df_i_M$visit_alpha), 
             rawplot.ylabel = str_vec1[i],
             show.legend = FALSE))
}
```

## Score pairs

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

alpha <- 0.3
  
thresholds <- res_all_component %>% filter(sex == "All", group == "PD vs HC+OND") %>% droplevels() %>% select(tests, cut_all) 
thresholds$direction <- rep("",nrow(thresholds))
thresholds$cut <- rep(0,nrow(thresholds))
for (i in 1:nrow(thresholds)) {
  thresholds$direction[i] <- str_split(thresholds$cut_all[i], " ")[[1]][1]
  thresholds$cut[i] <- as.numeric(str_split(thresholds$cut_all[i], " ")[[1]][2])
}

test_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]

df <- df_PREDIGT2 %>% select(ID, group, all_of(test_vec))
pList <- list()
for (i in 1:3) {
  if (i == 1) {
    ind <- c(1,2)
    xstr <- "Questionnaire Score"
  } else if (i == 2) {
    ind <- c(3,4)
    xstr <- "Smell Test Score"
  } else {
    ind <- c(5,6)
    xstr <- "PREDIGT Summary Score"
  }
  
  dfi <- df %>% select(ID, group, all_of(test_vec)[ind]) 
  names(dfi) <- c("ID", "group", "original", "simplified")
  
  thresholds_i <- thresholds[ind,4]
  
  # Min-Max Scaling
  min <- min(dfi$original)
  max <- max(dfi$original)
  dfi$original <- (dfi$original - min)/(max - min)
  thresholds_i[1] <- (thresholds_i[1] - min)/(max - min)
  
  min <- min(dfi$simplified)
  max <- max(dfi$simplified)
  dfi$simplified <- (dfi$simplified - min)/(max - min)
  thresholds_i[2] <- (thresholds_i[2] - min)/(max - min)
  
  if (i == 2) {
    dfi <- dfi %>%
      mutate(
        class_original = ifelse(original <= thresholds_i[1], "PD", "Other"),
        class_simplified = ifelse(simplified <= thresholds_i[2], "PD", "Other")
      ) %>% 
      mutate(not_matched = factor(ifelse(class_original == class_simplified, "No", "Yes")))
    
    dfi_long <- dfi %>%
      pivot_longer(-c(ID, group, class_original, class_simplified, not_matched), names_to = "test", values_to = "value") 
    dfi_long$group <- factor(dfi_long$group)
    
    # https://stackoverflow.com/questions/39533456/how-to-jitter-both-geom-line-and-geom-point-by-the-same-magnitude
    set.seed(100)
    pd <- position_dodge(0.1)
    
    p1 <- ggplot(dfi_long, aes(test, value, group = ID, color = group, alpha = not_matched)) + 
      geom_line(position = pd) +
      geom_point(position = pd)+
      scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("#1F78B4", "#AF026C", "#33A02C"))+
      scale_alpha_discrete(guide = "none")+ 
      annotate("rect", xmin = 0.7, xmax = 1.3, 
               ymin = 0, ymax = thresholds_i[1], alpha = alpha, fill = "#AF026C")+ 
      annotate("rect", xmin = 0.7, xmax = 1.3, 
               ymin = thresholds_i[1], ymax = 1, alpha = alpha, fill = "#1F78B4")+ 
      annotate("rect", xmin = 1.7, xmax = 2.3, 
               ymin = 0, ymax = thresholds_i[2], alpha = alpha, fill = "#AF026C")+ 
      annotate("rect", xmin = 1.7, xmax = 2.3, 
               ymin = thresholds_i[2], ymax = 1, alpha = alpha, fill = "#1F78B4")+
      facet_wrap(~group, nrow = 3, axes = "all", axis.labels = "all")+
      theme_bw()+
      theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title.x = element_blank())+
      labs(title = xstr)
  } else {
    dfi <- dfi %>%
      mutate(
        class_original = ifelse(original >= thresholds_i[1], "PD", "Other"),
        class_simplified = ifelse(simplified >= thresholds_i[2], "PD", "Other")
      ) %>% 
      mutate(not_matched = factor(ifelse(class_original == class_simplified, "No", "Yes")))
    
    dfi_long <- dfi %>%
      pivot_longer(-c(ID, group, class_original, class_simplified, not_matched), names_to = "test", values_to = "value") 
    dfi_long$group <- factor(dfi_long$group)
    
    p1 <- ggplot(dfi_long, aes(test, value, group = ID, color = group, alpha = not_matched)) + 
      geom_line()+
      geom_point()+
      scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("#1F78B4", "#AF026C", "#33A02C"))+
      scale_alpha_discrete(guide = "none")+ 
      annotate("rect", xmin = 0.7, xmax = 1.3, 
               ymin = 0, ymax = thresholds_i[1], alpha = alpha, fill = "#1F78B4")+ 
      annotate("rect", xmin = 0.7, xmax = 1.3, 
               ymin = thresholds_i[1], ymax = 1, alpha = alpha, fill = "#AF026C")+ 
      annotate("rect", xmin = 1.7, xmax = 2.3, 
               ymin = 0, ymax = thresholds_i[2], alpha = alpha, fill = "#1F78B4")+ 
      annotate("rect", xmin = 1.7, xmax = 2.3, 
               ymin = thresholds_i[2], ymax = 1, alpha = alpha, fill = "#AF026C")+
      facet_wrap(~group, nrow = 3, axes = "all", axis.labels = "all")+
      theme_bw()+
      theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
            axis.title.x = element_blank())+
      labs(title = xstr)
  }
  
  
  
  if (i == 1) {
    p1 <- p1 + labs(y = "Scaled (min-max) scores")
  } else {
    p1 <- p1 + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }
  
  pList[[i]] <- p1
}

ggarrange(plotlist = pList, ncol = 3, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")
```
